issue.title: POST /api/review/:id/request is destructive on already-passed reviews — should refuse or take a --nudge flag
acceptanceCriteria: Default behavior refuses reset when reviewStatus === 'passed' AND reviewedAtCommit matches HEAD
\`?nudge=true\` re-emits \`test.passed\` lifecycle event only — no status writes
Response includes a clear hint when refused (which flag to use)
Unit tests for all three branches (default-passed-refused, nudge, force)
Regression: existing callers in CLI / dashboard that legitimately need a full reset call with \`?force=true\`

blocker.title: Nudge requests synchronously scan workspace state before the cheap early return
